name: claude
description: The window as the Claude app: warm near-black paper with the clay accent, replies set in serif in a narrow reading column, your prompt in a soft rounded pill, round tabs and panes, sessions by project with their branch and pull request. Every New Tab is Claude's home (a greeting, one prompt box that starts a Claude chat, your recents), the sidebar carries Claude's usage left, and each chat's Session Info gets a Claude Code status line. Command-N starts a Claude chat.
